p: I come from operations: I coordinated teams, audits and processes before moving on to automate them. That background helps me understand the business problem before choosing the tool.

Today I work with the Claude, OpenAI and DeepSeek APIs, with n8n and Power Automate, and with AI-assisted development in Python and JavaScript. I study Industrial Engineering at UADE. I like to launch fast with what already exists and build custom only what is needed.
I also develop software: the WhatsApp + Odoo conversational platform, custom Tienda Nube apps, API integrations and a demo CRM (FastAPI, React and PostgreSQL) with 33 tests and open source code.
now: Developing automations and AI solutions at Softtek
Building my second brain with Obsidian, MCP and Claude
Studying Industrial Engineering and a SAP diploma at UADE
